messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] Install Error
parts:
Hi,
that is some Mac issue and most likely not related to camtrapR. See here and here. The links also provide potential solutions. Using install.packages() should be easier than using the tgz file.
When installing from a tarball the dependencies ( ‘generics’, ‘sf’, ‘sp’, ‘secr’, ‘data.table’, ‘lubridate) are not installed automatically, hence the installation of camtrapR fails. So you'd need to install them first, and this can be a pain to do manually.
Best regards,
Jürgen


Am Mo., 10. Okt. 2022 um 19:32 Uhr schrieb Mathia Gerner <wowg...@gmail.com>:
Hi,

When I try to instal camtrapR I get "Error in install.packages : Unrecognized response “install.packages("camtrapR")”".

If I use tgz file I get "ERROR: dependencies ‘generics’, ‘sf’, ‘sp’, ‘secr’, ‘data.table’, ‘lubridate’ are not available for package ‘camtrapR’
* removing ‘/Library/Frameworks/R.framework/Versions/4.2/Resources/library/camtrapR’
Warning in install.packages :
  installation of package ‘/Users/mathiagerner/Downloads/camtrapR_2.2.0.tar.gz’ had non-zero exit status"

I'm using R 4.2.1 binary for macOS 11 (Big Sur).

How do I get it installed?

Best regards,
Mathia Gerner
